title: Built-in Functions
scenario: Terraform ships with functions for strings, collections, numbers and encoding. Normalise a bucket name with lower() and take a short prefix with substr().
constraints: Use lower() to build the bucket name.
Use substr() to derive a short name.
Reference local.bucket_name from the short name.

focus.title: Normalise the bucket name
focus.todo: Use lower and substr in the locals block.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Use lower and substr in the locals block. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: bucket_name; short_name. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.project_name`, `local.bucket_name`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.

test_manifest.title: short name references the bucket name
